declared_in: AGENTS.md (section: Markdown dialect and the variant label)
note: The corpus is written and rendered as CommonMark 0.31.2. Local extensions the corpus also uses are NOT CommonMark and are not claimed by this pin: pipe tables, [[wikilinks]], [!callout] blocks, and the Lens renderer's presentation attributes (heading id anchors, figure-wrapped images, target/rel on external links). The conformance subset therefore contains no table case from the spec (the spec defines no tables); the renderer's table behaviour is a local extension, pinned by the Lens's own tests, not by this file.
